d: The Assistant Manager – F&B Loyalty Program will lead the internal launch, sales, and daily operation of the hotel’s paid annual membership program at Wyndham Garden Manama. Reporting to the Cluster Marketing Manager, this role is responsible for driving membership sales revenue, repeat dining covers, and utilization across all participating outlets, rooms, and spa facilities.

The incumbent will manage outbound and in-hotel member acquisition, oversee digital/physical membership certificates and redemptions, ensure strict compliance with Bahrain data privacy regulations, and act as the primary point of contact for members in accordance with Wyndham brand standards.
It is not the intent of this Job Description to cover all aspects of the position but to highlight the most important areas of responsibility.
q: Manage and nurture relationships with active loyalty members to encourage repeat dining and brand advocacy for Wyndham Garden Manama.
Handle member inquiries, card/digital profile activations, tier questions, and feedback promptly and professionally.
Coordinate exclusive member events, culinary tastings, brunch previews, and seasonal gatherings at the hotel.
Maintain high levels of member satisfaction and resolve any redemption disputes or service concerns in line with Count on Me! standards.

Alongside these key competencies, the incumbent of the role will be required to demonstrate the fundamentals of the company’s Count on Me! service culture to be responsive, respectful, and deliver a great experience.
Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum 2–4 years’ experience in hotel loyalty programs, dining club management, hospitality sales, or F&B marketing in a similar role.
Direct experience selling paid hospitality/dining memberships and managing voucher/certificate programs is strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of hotel F&B operations, POS discount configuration, and CRM platforms.
Familiarity with customer data privacy best practices (including Bahrain PDPL consent rules).
Excellent communication skills in English (Arabic is a strong advantage).
Proven ability to meet membership sales targets and manage VIP guest relationships.
Any other reasonable duties as directed by the Cluster Marketing Manager.
r: Internal Loyalty Program Strategy & Revenue Generation
Lead the commercial execution of the hotel’s in-house paid annual loyalty program at Wyndham Garden Manama.
Achieve monthly and annual targets for paid membership enrollments, membership renewals, and incremental F&B, room, and spa revenue.
Drive repeat dining and average check growth across all participating outlets.
Maximize 100% hotel-retained membership fee revenue while monitoring benefit redemption costs to protect outlet profit margins.
Identify low-occupancy dining periods and implement targeted member offers to boost covers during off-peak days and meal periods.
Proactively drive new membership sales through in-outlet guest engagement, front-desk referrals, corporate pitches, local networking, and outbound telemarketing.
Manage and build a sales pipeline of corporate accounts, diplomatic missions, expat groups, and local Bahrain residents to grow the paid member base.
Execute structured renewal and referral campaigns to maximize member retention and year-over-year program growth.

Ensure all guest outreach, database building, and telemarketing activities strictly comply with the Bahrain Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), ensuring explicit guest consent is obtained before marketing solicitation.
Cross-sell participating outlet dining, Best Flexible Rate room discounts, and spa privileges to prospective and active members.
x: Administer all program entitlements, including tiered dining discounts (e.g., solo, couple, and group dining tiers), beverage discounts, room rate privileges, and spa discounts.
Oversee the issuance, tracking, and redemption of member complimentary certificates (such as dining vouchers, complimentary night/upgrade certificates, celebration cakes, and spa vouchers).
Coordinate with Marketing and Revenue teams to structure, price, and promote special member packages (such as Anniversary Packages and Weekend Getaways).
Clearly communicate blackout dates, outlet closures, and terms and conditions to members and operational teams to prevent booking conflicts.
Manage the day-to-day administration of the loyalty CRM/POS platform, ensuring accurate member records, 12-month membership validity tracking, and payment reconciliation.
Conduct regular audits of outlet discount redemptions and certificate usage across the property to prevent unauthorized discounts or program misuse.
Ensure all promotional memberships (e.g., complimentary VIP/media passes) are strictly capped, logged, and approved by Hotel Leadership.
Maintain accurate financial records of membership fee collections, refunds, and chargebacks in coordination with Finance.
Collaborate with the Cluster Marketing Manager, Director of F&B, and Revenue Management to evaluate the financial performance and redemption cost of program benefits.
Analyze member dining patterns, favorite outlets, and redemption trends to support menu engineering and promotional decisions.
Recommend adjustments to blackout dates, package pricing, or promotional terms based on outlet capacity and profitability.
Monitor competing hotel dining clubs and F&B loyalty programs across Manama and Juffair.
Benchmark membership pricing, discount structures, and partner perks in the Bahrain market to keep the hotel program competitive.
Share market feedback, member suggestions, and corporate partnership leads with the Cluster Marketing Manager.
Prepare weekly and monthly loyalty reports detailing membership sales, cash collections, renewal rates, redemption volume, and outlet-by-outlet incremental revenue.
Track individual sales performance and outlet sign-up contributions against monthly budgets.
Provide monthly reconciliation reports to Finance covering net membership revenue and redeemed certificate liabilities.
Train and brief restaurant managers, servers, cashiers, spa reception, and front-office teams at Wyndham Garden Manama on membership rules, POS discount codes, and certificate validation.
Coordinate closely with Restaurant Managers, Reservations, and Front Office to ensure smooth recognition and seating of loyalty members.
Ensure all participating outlets are accurately listed and updated across all membership collateral and digital platforms.
Work with the Cluster Marketing Manager to design and distribute membership brochures, digital collateral, email newsletters, and social media campaigns.
Represent Wyndham Garden Manama at corporate roadshows, local business events, and community activations to sell memberships.
Develop corporate tie-ups and group membership deals with local companies, banks, and institutions in Bahrain.
Maintaining a business environment based on the Code of Conduct and Company Vision.
Maintain and enhance the open-door policy to all team members providing advice and guidance when needed in regards to their issues or concerns and/or grievances.

Assist the Cluster Marketing Manager with direct reports (such as Loyalty Sales Executives or Ambassadors), including recruitment, performance management (Appraisal/PDP), coaching, and disciplinary matters.
Ensure that your department is fully compliant with Wyndham people processes and deadlines that govern all Wyndham properties (e.g., WES, Success Matters, Probation reviews, etc.).
Ensure 100% compliance with all mandatory training for your department(s), as well as ensuring Departmental Trainers are positively encouraged.

Assist the Head of Department in controlling LTO, Absence, and Payroll in your department in conjunction with the HR Leader on property to ensure any areas of concern are monitored and rectified to meet HR BSC Targets.
Assist the Head of Department to conduct interviews for relevant roles in conjunction with HR.
Ensure that you dine in the Team Member restaurant at least three times a week and provide the HR Leader on property with feedback.
Support WeCom with quarterly People, Community, and Sustainability engagement events.
Conduct or chair regular communication meetings with your team and actively participate in relevant hotel business and F&B meetings to facilitate effective communication.
Conduct documented 121s with all direct reports.

q: Prepare and serve a full range of specialty coffees, teas, mocktails, and luxury café beverages to brand standards.
Provide engaging, intuitive, and personalized service that anticipates guest needs.
Share product knowledge—beans, brewing methods, origins—to elevate the guest’s experience.
Create a welcoming atmosphere that aligns with the hotel’s luxury identity and service culture.
Operate coffee equipment including espresso machines, grinders, brewers, and POS systems with accuracy and care.
Ensure all beverages are prepared consistently and presented elegantly.
Maintain par levels of supplies (coffee, milk alternatives, syrups, pastries, china, etc.).
Follow opening, closing, and shift-change procedures efficiently.
Adhere to IHG and brand-specific service guidelines and luxury service cues.
Uphold high standards of hygiene, sanitation, and food safety in compliance with local regulations and hotel policies.
Ensure all work areas, display cases, and equipment remain clean, organized, and visually appealing.
Assist in menu refinement, specialty drink development, and seasonal offerings.
Work closely with the Food & Beverage team, Guest Relations, and Culinary departments to ensure seamless service.
Communicate guest preferences or feedback to management to enhance service quality.
Support the team during peak service times and contribute to a positive, professional working environment.

d: Job Number EGYPT00383 Job Type Teaching School / Entity Name The International School of Choueifat, Cairo Department Teaching & Academics

SABIS® is a global education network that has an active presence in 21 countries on five continents and educates students in both the private and public sectors. SABIS® schools implement the proven, proprietary SABIS® Educational System, which has been developed and refined for over 140 years.

All students in the SABIS® Network benefit from a long tradition of excellence in education, a reputation that is rooted in a well-developed philosophy that seeks to provide students with a top-quality education that prepares them to meet the challenges of a changing world.
For more information about the SABIS® Network, visit: www.sabis.net.

Responsible for ensuring students’ academic success and helping them reach their full potential through the effective implementation of the SABIS® curriculum and philosophy, as well as the consistent application of SABIS® teaching methodologies.
q: Bachelor’s Degree in Education or in a related field
English Proficient (Native English is required for Infant and English Teacher positions)
A minimum of 1 year of teaching experience
Must meet all employment requirements including, but not limited to, country and local education and certification requirements, reference checks, and criminal background checks.
Additional details about this position will only be provided to short-listed candidates.

r: Teaching classes using provided lesson plans, and when required, developing lesson plans based on approved pacing charts to ensure the effective delivery of the curriculum and proper implementation of the SABIS® Point System.
Marking exams related to the taught subject in accordance with the schedule and material provided by the department.
Discussing student disciplinary and academic performance concerns with the Academic Quality Controller (AQC) and Head of Department (HOD), as needed.
Implementing the SABIS® Point System to ensure an environment conducive to learning in the classroom.
Proctoring exams as required, ensuring an adequate and properly managed test environment.
Providing support, guidance, and motivation to academically low-performing students to help them improve and achieve their full potential.

Assisting with additional school duties as assigned, including testing students, substituting for absent teachers, organizing students for lunches and buses, controlling crowd and traffic, and other administrative tasks.
Preparing and participating in student life activities and events such as but not limited to art, open houses, and physical education, in coordination with the Student Life Coordinator (SLC).
Attending training sessions when needed and as requested by the School Management to enhance the understanding of the SABIS® system and improve the overall students’ performance.
Performing other related tasks or projects as they arise and as delegated by the School Management.
